rationale: The defense exclude leaked once in production (Anduril led the Aug 20 digest) because it was prose evaluated per-posting at ranking time. Enforcing it here makes it a fetch-time and prefilter-time gate instead: a blocked company is never fetched, so it can never be ranked, and a tripwire hit is quarantined before any judgment is applied.
tripwire_notes: Matched as whole words (regex \b...\b) against company + title + posting text. One strong term quarantines; weak terms need two, because they appear constantly in EEO boilerplate. Measured on a live 1511-posting harvest: naive case-insensitive substring matching quarantined 127 postings, 96 of them from 'nato' matching inside unrelated words and 27 from 'military' in equal-opportunity text -- it flagged accountants at a robotics company. Under-blocking let Anduril lead the Aug 20 digest; over-blocking would have silently eaten 8% of the corpus. Both are quarantines, never silent drops, so the count is always visible in the run report.
role_filter_notes: Applied to the TITLE only. Matching new-grad phrases in posting text alone pulled in recruiters, accountants and a Workplace Experience Manager, because 'early career' and 'campus' live in company boilerplate. A technical title term is required, and seniority terms are excluded outright since no new-grad or internship req is titled Senior or Director.
terms_notes: Set these to the internship terms you can actually do (SETUP.md asks). Terms come from the feeds as a structured field, so winter internships no longer have to be found by regexing posting text -- the old prompt did that across 34 boards and found zero; the feeds carry 237 Winter 2027 technical internships open to a Bachelor's.
vertical_notes: Ranking prior only, never a filter. Keep coverage broad: these verticals float roles to the top of the ranking, but a strong role outside them still reaches you.
blocked_match_notes: Blocked names are matched as whole words against the company name and the opening of the posting text, one direction only. Company alone is not enough: the feeds shortened 'Applied Intuition' to 'Applied', which slipped the denylist while the posting text said 'Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI'. Exact matching had earlier let 'General Dynamics UK' through, and bidirectional substring matching over-blocked Intuit via 'Applied Intuition' and Mosaic via 'SAIC'.
quota_notes: Buckets, not one global top-N. is_new was the first sort key, which made 3,224 of 4,275 eligible roles unreachable: Xaira's AI Scientist Intern in computational protein design was 10 days old and never surfaced. The standing bucket restores what the original prompt called backfill, limited to roles that are on the watchlist, in a target vertical, or at a small employer. Tune the quotas to what you want: someone after a full-time offer should keep internship buckets small; someone after an internship should do the opposite.
open_level_notes: Watchlist startups post plain titles and hire graduates into them, so their boards are read without the new-grad phrase (category open-level). Three guards keep that honest: a role asking 3+ years of experience anywhere in the posting is dropped (too_experienced), titles from the exclude list are dropped (Harvey's 'Legal Engineer' reqs are for lawyers; 'II' is a second-level req), and a location naming only non-US places is dropped (outside_us; Legora's 72 reqs were mostly Europe). Measured 2026-11-02: 231 technical non-senior watchlist roles had been dropped by the title gate. Later the same day the first harvest kept 861 open-level roles, many of them hardware, data-center and wet-lab reqs (Anthropic's data-center electrical engineers, Fervo's reservoir engineers, NewLimit's mRNA scientists), so an open-level title must also carry a software, ML or data term (open_level_title_requires). Audit of out/watchlist-dropped.json the same evening: an 'ii' exclude was killing entry-level 'I/II' titles (Lila ML Scientist I/II, Iambic Software Engineer I/II), and the required-term list missed research and deployed titles (Goodfire Research Scientist, Hippocratic AI Forward Deployment Engineer, Cognition Partner Deployed Engineer, Cursor Field Engineer). Both fixed; wet-lab titles are excluded by name instead. The experience cut moved from 3 to 4 years: Benchling's agents role asks 3+, and min_years reaches the ranking step so it can judge.
seniority_notes: 'staff' is a seniority word except in 'member of technical staff', which startups use for every level: it dropped 99 watchlist roles on 2026-11-02, including Decagon's 'Member of Technical Staff - New Grad (2027 Start)' and Abridge's 'Member of Technical Staff, Early Career'. The phrase is removed before the seniority check.
